things.title: What does the empty Signals page offer before launch?

options.name: A pointer to Personas
options.difference: The empty page explains there are no customers yet and sends you to Personas, where each persona is easy to send on a mission.

options.name: Send testers, right here
options.difference: The empty page shows each persona with the kobold's suggested task, all ticked, and one Send; signals fill the same page.

options.name: One click, everyone goes
options.difference: The empty page has one button that sends every persona with its suggested task, no list to check.

things.title: What one AI tester goes through
things.diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[A persona, e.g. a customer] --> T[The kobold suggests a task from the customer's journey]
  T --> A[The customer opens the shop app on this computer]
  A --> S[Step by step: what it did, what it expected, what happened]
  S --> R[What it ran into becomes signals: bug, idea, open question]
  R --> G[Signals page, each linked to its step]

things.name: One at a time, by hand
things.difference: On a persona's page: the kobold suggests a task, the team edits it and presses Run; several can be started side by side.
things.said: The deleted `packages/kits/starters/nestjs-backend/.env.test.example` was already gone when I started. I didn't touch it.

things.text: Signals stay signals (bug, idea, open question). Before launch, the empty Signals page invites the team to send the AI testers over the app to find what to improve.

things.title: From the empty Signals page
things.diagram:
flowchart LR
  E[Signals page is empty: 'No customers yet. Send your personas to try the app.'] --> P[Personas: cards showing who each one is]
  P --> O[A persona's page: who they are]
  O --> M[Next mission, marked Suggested: Send]
  M --> R[The persona tries its own app, step by step]
  R --> S[Signals appear, each linked to its step]

things.text: Prototype A misses the point: it starts with signals already there. The next prototype starts from an empty Signals page.

things.title: How is a persona sent on a mission?

options.name: One suggested mission
options.difference: The kobold suggests one mission from the persona's journey; Send, or change the words first.

options.name: Pick from a few
options.difference: The kobold suggests three missions, one per part of the journey; tick one or more and Send.

options.name: Write your own
options.difference: An empty box for the mission, with the journey beside it as a reminder; no suggestion.

things.name: One suggested mission
things.difference: The kobold suggests one mission from the persona's journey; Send, or change the words first.
things.said:
**Last words for the card:**
- Signals before launch: the kobold suggests one mission from a persona's journey, which you send or reword first; the tester goes through the steps and its bugs, ideas and open questions appear under the step where each happened.
- Where to look: the Signals page while the live app is not connected (new file `signals/testers.tsx`, used from `signals-page.tsx`); "Connect the live app" is now a line at the bottom.
- No library added and no piece copied; the missions and their signals are made up.

things.text: A2 must show: the empty Signals page (calm illustration, one short sentence) sends you to Personas. The overview cards only show who each persona is (face, name, description); a card opens the persona's page: who they are, "Send on a mission" with the kobold's suggestion (badge) and Send, then one list of missions with the signals each found. No switch, no journey; real customers' signals only after launch.

things.title: What does a persona's card show in the overview?

options.name: The suggested mission
options.difference: Always the next mission the kobold suggests, with Send; what it did before is on the persona's own page.

options.name: Its current mission
options.difference: The mission it is on or last did, with what it found; a new mission is started from the persona's own page.

options.name: Depends on the moment
options.difference: While on a mission: that mission and its progress. Otherwise: the suggested next one, with Send.

options.name: Who this is
options.difference: Each card shows the face, name and description, not editable; clicking it opens the persona's page, where missions are sent.

things.title: What sits under "Send on a mission" on a persona's page?

options.name: One list: missions
options.difference: No switch. Each past mission with the signals it found; real customers' signals appear as a second section only once there are any, after launch.

options.name: Keep the switch
options.difference: Two tabs, Missions and Signals, as today; signals from missions show in both.

things.text: For the build, new compared with today: several personas on a mission at once (today one waits for the other), the kobold suggesting a mission, signals of kind "idea" and "open question" with the step where they happened, and "Tests" renamed to missions. Later: missions again after each merge.
